explainer.summary: WETH9 is a contract that wraps ETH into ERC20-compatible WETH tokens via a payable deposit function and allows unwrapping via withdraw. It implements standard token operations using balanceOf and allowance mappings, with totalSupply returning the contract's ETH balance. The provided source contains no owner, admin, or proxy logic.

key_functions.name: deposit
key_functions.what: payable function that adds msg.value to balanceOf[msg.sender] and emits Deposit

key_functions.name: withdraw
key_functions.what: requires balanceOf[msg.sender] >= wad, subtracts wad, transfers ETH to msg.sender, emits Withdrawal

key_functions.name: approve
key_functions.what: sets allowance[msg.sender][guy] = wad and emits Approval

key_functions.name: transfer
key_functions.what: calls transferFrom(msg.sender, dst, wad)

key_functions.name: transferFrom
key_functions.what: checks balanceOf[src] >= wad, deducts from allowance if src != msg.sender and allowance != uint(-1), updates balances, emits Transfer

key_functions.name: totalSupply
key_functions.what: view function returning this.balance

key_functions.name: fallback
key_functions.what: payable function that calls deposit()

explainer.upgradeability: Not upgradeable; the contract has no owner, proxy, or selfdestruct logic in the source.
user_risks: withdraw requires sufficient balanceOf[msg.sender] or it reverts
transferFrom deducts from allowance unless it equals uint(-1)
integration_tips: call deposit() or send ETH to the contract to wrap
call withdraw(wad) to unwrap and receive ETH
use approve and transferFrom for ERC20-style interactions

explainer.summary: TetherToken.sol implements an ERC20 token with owner-controlled pause, blacklist, fee, mint/redeem and deprecation mechanisms. Transfers and approvals are forwarded to an upgraded contract when the deprecated flag is set. The owner address receives any transfer fees and can blacklist addresses or destroy their balances.

key_functions.name: transfer
key_functions.what: Applies optional fee then moves tokens; reverts if sender is blacklisted or contract is paused; forwards to upgraded contract if deprecated.

key_functions.name: transferFrom
key_functions.what: Same fee and blacklist logic as transfer; reduces allowance unless MAX_UINT; forwards when deprecated.

key_functions.name: addBlackList
key_functions.what: Owner-only function that marks an address as blacklisted.

key_functions.name: destroyBlackFunds
key_functions.what: Owner-only; zeros a blacklisted address balance and subtracts it from _totalSupply.

key_functions.name: deprecate
key_functions.what: Owner-only; sets deprecated=true and records the upgradedAddress.

key_functions.name: issue
key_functions.what: Owner-only; increases owner balance and _totalSupply after overflow checks.

key_functions.name: redeem
key_functions.what: Owner-only; decreases owner balance and _totalSupply after sufficient-balance checks.

key_functions.name: setParams
key_functions.what: Owner-only; sets basisPointsRate (<20) and maximumFee (<50) for transfer fees.

key_functions.name: pause
key_functions.what: Owner-only; sets paused=true when not already paused.

admin_powers: add or remove addresses from blacklist
issue or redeem tokens to/from owner
deprecate contract and point to upgraded address
explainer.upgradeability: Boolean deprecated flag plus upgradedAddress; when true, transfer/transferFrom/approve/balanceOf/allowance/totalSupply delegate to UpgradedStandardToken at that address via the corresponding ByLegacy methods.
user_risks: owner can pause all transfers
owner can blacklist any address and block its transfers
owner can permanently destroy blacklisted balances
owner can mint or burn tokens at will
small transfer fees may be sent to owner when basisPointsRate > 0
integration_tips: check !deprecated and !paused before assuming standard ERC20 behavior
call getBlackListStatus before accepting tokens from an address
totalSupply and balanceOf must be read from the live contract or its upgraded proxy
approve must set allowance to zero before changing a non-zero value to avoid the documented race condition

explainer.summary: FiatTokenV2_2 extends FiatTokenV2_1 and adds initializeV2_2 to migrate blacklisted accounts from _deprecatedBlacklisted to the new balanceAndBlacklistStates structure while updating the symbol and setting _initializedVersion to 3. It overrides balance and blacklist helpers to store balances in the lower 255 bits and blacklist status in the high bit, and provides signature-based permit/authorization functions that call internal _permit/_transferWithAuthorization etc. methods. All state-changing functions require whenNotPaused and notBlacklisted checks where applicable.

key_functions.name: initializeV2_2
key_functions.what: Requires _initializedVersion==2, sets symbol to newSymbol, migrates listed accounts from _deprecatedBlacklisted to _blacklist, blacklists the contract itself, and sets _initializedVersion=3.

key_functions.name: permit
key_functions.what: External whenNotPaused wrapper calling _permit(owner,spender,value,deadline,signature) for EIP-2612 style allowance updates.

key_functions.name: transferWithAuthorization
key_functions.what: External whenNotPaused notBlacklisted wrapper calling _transferWithAuthorization with from/to/value/validAfter/validBefore/nonce/signature.

key_functions.name: receiveWithAuthorization
key_functions.what: External whenNotPaused notBlacklisted wrapper calling _receiveWithAuthorization, additionally ensuring payee matches caller.

key_functions.name: cancelAuthorization
key_functions.what: External whenNotPaused wrapper calling _cancelAuthorization(authorizer,nonce,signature).

key_functions.name: _setBlacklistState
key_functions.what: Internal override that ORs (1<<255) into balanceAndBlacklistStates to blacklist or resets to _balanceOf to unblacklist.

key_functions.name: _setBalance
key_functions.what: Internal override enforcing _balance <= (2^255-1) and not blacklisted before writing to balanceAndBlacklistStates.

key_functions.name: _isBlacklisted
key_functions.what: Internal view override returning true if balanceAndBlacklistStates[_account] >> 255 == 1.

key_functions.name: _balanceOf
key_functions.what: Internal view override returning balanceAndBlacklistStates[_account] & ((1<<255)-1).

key_functions.name: approve
key_functions.what: Override of FiatTokenV1 that calls _approve under whenNotPaused.

explainer.upgradeability: Implementation contract using initializeV2_2 to advance from _initializedVersion 2 to 3; inherits prior versioned initializers.
user_risks: Blacklisted accounts cannot transfer or have balances updated; high bit in balanceAndBlacklistStates marks blacklist status.
Balances cannot exceed (2^255-1) or _setBalance reverts.
Signature-based functions (permit, authorizations) are only callable when not paused.
integration_tips: Call initializeV2_2 once after deployment with accountsToBlacklist and desired symbol.
Use the bytes signature variants of permit/transferWithAuthorization for EOA or contract wallets.
Query _balanceOf and _isBlacklisted via the overridden internal logic rather than direct storage reads.

explainer.summary: Dai is an ERC20 token contract with authorization-controlled minting and burning, plus EIP-712 permit support. It inherits LibNote for event logging on privileged calls and initializes the deployer as the sole ward in the constructor. All state changes for supply and allowances are implemented directly in the provided dai.sol without any proxy or delegatecall logic.

key_functions.name: rely
key_functions.what: Grants ward status to an address when called by an existing ward (emits note).

key_functions.name: deny
key_functions.what: Revokes ward status from an address when called by an existing ward (emits note).

key_functions.name: mint
key_functions.what: Increases balance and totalSupply for a user; callable only by wards.

key_functions.name: burn
key_functions.what: Decreases balance and totalSupply after allowance check; callable by anyone on their own balance or approved spenders.

key_functions.name: transferFrom
key_functions.what: Moves tokens with allowance deduction unless allowance is uint(-1); emits Transfer.

key_functions.name: approve
key_functions.what: Sets allowance and emits Approval.

key_functions.name: permit
key_functions.what: Sets infinite or zero allowance via EIP-712 signature after nonce, expiry and signature validation.

key_functions.name: push
key_functions.what: Alias that calls transferFrom(msg.sender, usr, wad).

key_functions.name: pull
key_functions.what: Alias that calls transferFrom(usr, msg.sender, wad).

admin_powers: rely(address) and deny(address) to manage the wards mapping
mint(address,uint) to create new Dai tokens
explainer.upgradeability: No upgradeability; the contract contains no proxy, delegatecall, or storage-migration mechanisms.
user_risks: Wards can mint arbitrary amounts of Dai at any time
Wards can grant or revoke mint rights to other addresses
integration_tips: Check wards[msg.sender] == 1 before expecting mint capability
Use allowance == uint(-1) pattern for gas-efficient infinite approvals
Permit calls require exact DOMAIN_SEPARATOR computed with the deployed chainId

explainer.summary: UniswapV2Factory (constructor takes _feeToSetter) deploys UniswapV2Pair instances via create2 in createPair and stores them in getPair/allPairs. It exposes feeTo/feeToSetter which are only mutable by the current feeToSetter via setFeeTo and setFeeToSetter. All pair logic (mint/burn/swap) lives in the separate UniswapV2Pair contract initialized once by the factory.

key_functions.name: createPair
key_functions.what: Creates a new UniswapV2Pair for token0/token1 using create2, initializes it, and records it in getPair and allPairs (reverts if identical addresses, zero address, or pair exists).

key_functions.name: setFeeTo
key_functions.what: Sets the feeTo address; only callable by feeToSetter.

key_functions.name: setFeeToSetter
key_functions.what: Transfers feeToSetter role; only callable by current feeToSetter.

key_functions.name: getPair
key_functions.what: Returns the pair address for a given token0/token1 mapping (populated in both directions).

key_functions.name: allPairs
key_functions.what: Returns the pair address at a given index in the allPairs array.

key_functions.name: allPairsLength
key_functions.what: Returns the length of the allPairs array.

admin_powers: feeToSetter can call setFeeTo to change the protocol fee recipient
feeToSetter can call setFeeToSetter to transfer the admin role to any address
explainer.upgradeability: Not upgradeable; immutable deployment with no proxy or delegatecall patterns.
user_risks: feeToSetter is a single point of control that can redirect protocol fees
createPair reverts on duplicate pairs or invalid token ordering
Pair creation uses create2 so address is deterministic but depends on factory bytecode
integration_tips: Call createPair only from contracts that have already verified tokenA != tokenB and token0 != address(0)
Use getPair[token0][token1] before creating to avoid redundant calls
All pair interactions must go through the pair returned by the factory; never deploy UniswapV2Pair directly

explainer.summary: UniswapV2Router02 implements IUniswapV2Router02 with immutable factory and WETH addresses set in the constructor. It provides liquidity addition/removal and token/ETH swap functions (including fee-on-transfer variants) that delegate to UniswapV2Library for calculations and IUniswapV2Pair for pair operations, guarded by an ensure(deadline) modifier. No owner or admin state exists; the contract is not upgradeable.

key_functions.name: addLiquidity
key_functions.what: adds liquidity to a token pair after creating pair if needed and transfers to pair for minting

key_functions.name: addLiquidityETH
key_functions.what: adds liquidity with ETH by wrapping to WETH and minting LP tokens

key_functions.name: removeLiquidity
key_functions.what: burns LP tokens from pair and returns token amounts after deadline check

key_functions.name: swapExactTokensForTokens
key_functions.what: swaps exact input tokens for output via _swap after amount checks

key_functions.name: swapExactETHForTokens
key_functions.what: wraps ETH and swaps via _swap for exact input

key_functions.name: _swapSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens
key_functions.what: performs swaps for fee-on-transfer tokens by recalculating amounts from pair balances

key_functions.name: removeLiquidityETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens
key_functions.what: removes liquidity and transfers token balance directly for fee tokens

key_functions.name: quote
key_functions.what: calls UniswapV2Library.quote for amount calculations

key_functions.name: getAmountsOut
key_functions.what: calls UniswapV2Library.getAmountsOut using factory

explainer.upgradeability: not upgradeable; factory and WETH are immutable and set only in constructor
user_risks: deadline expiry reverts with EXPIRED
INSUFFICIENT_OUTPUT_AMOUNT or INSUFFICIENT_A_AMOUNT reverts on slippage
requires prior token approvals for transfers
integration_tips: pass current block.timestamp + buffer as deadline
use getAmountsOut/getAmountsIn for pre-flight quotes
handle ETH via WETH for ETH-involved calls

explainer.summary: SwapRouter is a stateless contract for executing exactInput and exactOutput swaps (single or multi-hop) against Uniswap V3 pools via the uniswapV3SwapCallback mechanism. It inherits PeripheryImmutableState (factory + WETH9 set at construction), PeripheryValidation (deadline checks), PeripheryPaymentsWithFee, Multicall, and SelfPermit; all swap logic lives in exactInputInternal/exactOutputInternal and delegates to pool.swap. No owner or privileged roles exist in the provided source.

key_functions.name: exactInputSingle
key_functions.what: Performs a single-hop exact-input swap with amountOutMinimum and deadline check.

key_functions.name: exactInput
key_functions.what: Performs a multi-hop exact-input swap by iterating the path, using the router as intermediate recipient until the final hop.

key_functions.name: exactOutputSingle
key_functions.what: Performs a single-hop exact-output swap with amountInMaximum and resets amountInCached.

key_functions.name: exactOutput
key_functions.what: Performs a multi-hop exact-output swap, reading the final amountIn from the transient amountInCached variable.

key_functions.name: uniswapV3SwapCallback
key_functions.what: Validates the callback, decodes SwapCallbackData, pays the required tokenIn (or continues the path for exact-output), and enforces amount0Delta/amount1Delta > 0.

key_functions.name: multicall
key_functions.what: Executes an array of delegatecalls to this contract and reverts with the decoded revert string on failure.

key_functions.name: selfPermit
key_functions.what: Calls IERC20Permit.permit on a token to approve the router for a given value and deadline.

key_functions.name: getPool
key_functions.what: Computes the deterministic pool address via PoolAddress.computeAddress using the immutable factory.

explainer.upgradeability: Not upgradeable; constructor sets immutable factory and WETH9, and no proxy or owner-controlled upgrade logic is present.
user_risks: Transactions revert after deadline via checkDeadline modifier.
Slippage protection relies on caller-supplied amountOutMinimum/amountInMaximum; insufficient values can result in worse execution.
Multi-hop paths must be correctly encoded; incorrect Path encoding leads to wrong pools or tokens.
amountInCached is transient and reset only on exactOutput paths; misuse outside the documented flow may leave stale values.
integration_tips: Batch approvals and swaps in a single multicall using selfPermit + exactInput/exactOutput.
Set recipient to address(0) to have the router custody intermediate tokens for multi-hop.
Use sqrtPriceLimitX96=0 for no price limit (contract enforces full amountOutReceived in exactOutputInternal).
Pay with WETH9 when msg.value covers the amount and token==WETH9 in PeripheryPayments.pay.

explainer.summary: Permit2 inherits from SignatureTransfer and AllowanceTransfer with no additional logic, unifying signature-based transfers (using nonceBitmap and _useUnorderedNonce) and allowance-based transfers (using the allowance mapping of PackedAllowance). It relies on EIP712 for _hashTypedData and DOMAIN_SEPARATOR with cached chainId, plus libraries for PermitHash, SignatureVerification, SafeTransferLib, and Allowance. Users must approve the contract before any transferFrom or permit operations as stated in the contract comment.

key_functions.name: approve
key_functions.what: Updates PackedAllowance amount and expiration for a token-spender pair and emits Approval.

key_functions.name: permit
key_functions.what: Verifies signature over PermitSingle or PermitBatch, checks sigDeadline, then calls _updateApproval which validates nonce and updates allowance.

key_functions.name: transferFrom
key_functions.what: Calls _transfer which checks expiration and amount against PackedAllowance, decrements if not max, then safeTransferFrom.

key_functions.name: lockdown
key_functions.what: Sets amount to 0 for each TokenSpenderPair in the caller's allowances and emits Lockdown.

key_functions.name: invalidateNonces
key_functions.what: Sets newNonce on PackedAllowance if greater than current, with delta limit of uint16 max, and emits NonceInvalidation.

key_functions.name: permitTransferFrom
key_functions.what: Calls _permitTransferFrom which checks deadline and amount, uses _useUnorderedNonce, verifies signature, then safeTransferFrom.

key_functions.name: permitWitnessTransferFrom
key_functions.what: Same as permitTransferFrom but hashes with witness and witnessTypeString via hashWithWitness.

key_functions.name: invalidateUnorderedNonces
key_functions.what: ORs mask into nonceBitmap[msg.sender][wordPos] and emits UnorderedNonceInvalidation.

explainer.upgradeability: Not upgradeable; deployed as a standalone contract with immutable EIP712 caches and no proxy or owner logic.
user_risks: Must call approve on tokens for Permit2 before any transferFrom or permit operations.
Signatures expire after sigDeadline or permit.deadline; expired ones revert with SignatureExpired.
Nonces must match exactly or _updateApproval and _useUnorderedNonce revert with InvalidNonce.
lockdown and invalidateNonces allow a user to revoke their own allowances or nonces irreversibly.
integration_tips: Call ERC20 approve on Permit2 before using allowance or transfer functions.
Use DOMAIN_SEPARATOR for off-chain EIP-712 signing and include correct chainId.
Batch permits and transfers reduce gas when handling multiple tokens or spenders.
Witness variants allow attaching extra data to the permit hash for custom verification.

explainer.summary: The Uni contract implements an ERC-20 token (UNI) with 1e9 total supply, 18 decimals, and built-in delegation for on-chain voting via checkpoints. It includes a single minter address that can mint up to 2% of supply once per year after mintingAllowedAfter, and supports EIP-2612 permits plus EIP-712 delegation by signature. All arithmetic uses SafeMath and 96-bit safe casts; the contract is not upgradeable.

key_functions.name: mint
key_functions.what: Callable only by minter after mintingAllowedAfter; mints up to mintCap percent of totalSupply and updates mintingAllowedAfter to +1 year.

key_functions.name: setMinter
key_functions.what: Callable only by current minter; replaces the minter address and emits MinterChanged.

key_functions.name: delegate
key_functions.what: Sets msg.sender's delegate and moves its current balance votes to the new delegatee via _moveDelegates.

key_functions.name: delegateBySig
key_functions.what: Validates EIP-712 delegation signature, checks nonce and expiry, then calls _delegate.

key_functions.name: getPriorVotes
key_functions.what: Binary-searches checkpoints to return an account's vote balance at a finalized past blockNumber.

key_functions.name: permit
key_functions.what: Validates EIP-712 permit signature and sets allowance; supports infinite approval via uint(-1).

key_functions.name: transferFrom
key_functions.what: Moves tokens after checking or deducting allowance (unless infinite) and updates delegates.

key_functions.name: approve
key_functions.what: Sets allowance; special-cases uint(-1) to uint96(-1) for infinite approval.

admin_powers: minter can call mint (subject to time and cap limits)
minter can call setMinter to transfer minting rights
explainer.upgradeability: None; constructor sets immutable minter and mintingAllowedAfter; no proxy or upgrade logic present.
user_risks: Single minter can mint 2% of supply annually after the initial delay
Approvals are subject to the known ERC-20 race condition described in the approve comment
Delegation and vote balances rely on 96-bit storage; amounts exceeding 2^96-1 revert
integration_tips: Use getPriorVotes for governance snapshots rather than balanceOf at current block
Call permit with deadline and signature to avoid separate approve transaction
Track DelegateVotesChanged events to maintain off-chain vote tallies

explainer.summary: LinkToken is a fixed-supply ERC20 token (totalSupply=10**27) that also implements ERC677 via transferAndCall. All tokens are assigned to the deployer in the constructor; the contract contains no owner, mint, or burn logic. Transfers, approvals, and transferAndCall are guarded by the validRecipient modifier that rejects address(0) and the token contract itself.

key_functions.name: transfer
key_functions.what: Moves tokens from msg.sender to _to after subtracting from sender and adding to recipient; emits Transfer.

key_functions.name: transferFrom
key_functions.what: Moves tokens using allowance, updates balances and allowance, emits Transfer.

key_functions.name: approve
key_functions.what: Sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value and emits Approval.

key_functions.name: increaseApproval
key_functions.what: Adds _addedValue to the current allowance and emits Approval.

key_functions.name: decreaseApproval
key_functions.what: Subtracts _subtractedValue from allowance (or sets to 0) and emits Approval.

key_functions.name: transferAndCall
key_functions.what: Calls super.transfer then Transfer with data; if _to is a contract, invokes onTokenTransfer via contractFallback.

key_functions.name: balanceOf
key_functions.what: Returns balances[_owner].

key_functions.name: allowance
key_functions.what: Returns allowed[_owner][_spender].

explainer.upgradeability: No upgradeability; the contract is a single immutable deployment with no proxy or delegatecall logic.
user_risks: All 10**27 tokens are minted to the deployer address at construction; no further supply changes are possible.
validRecipient blocks transfers/approvals to address(0) or the token contract itself.
Standard ERC20 allowance race condition is mitigated only if callers use increaseApproval/decreaseApproval.
integration_tips: Use transferAndCall when sending to a contract that implements ERC677Receiver.onTokenTransfer.
Call increaseApproval/decreaseApproval instead of approve when the current allowance is nonzero.
Check balanceOf and allowance via the public getters before performing transfers.

explainer.summary: GnosisSafe v1.3.0 is a multisig wallet singleton (constructor sets threshold=1 to prevent direct use) that inherits EtherPaymentFallback, Singleton, ModuleManager, OwnerManager, FallbackManager, GuardManager and others. It supports owner-based transaction execution via execTransaction after checkNSignatures, optional modules/fallback handlers set only in setup, and EIP-712 transaction hashing with nonce tracking.

key_functions.name: setup
key_functions.what: Initializes owners/threshold via setupOwners, optional fallbackHandler via internalSetFallbackHandler, modules via setupModules, and payment; emits SafeSetup.

key_functions.name: execTransaction
key_functions.what: Encodes tx data, increments nonce, verifies signatures with checkSignatures, optionally runs guard checks, executes via execute, handles payment, and emits success/failure.

key_functions.name: checkNSignatures
key_functions.what: Validates required number of signatures supporting ECDSA (v=27/28 or eth_sign), approved hashes (v=1), and contract signatures (v=0) using ISignatureValidator.

key_functions.name: approveHash
key_functions.what: Marks a hash as approved by an owner in approvedHashes mapping after owner check.

key_functions.name: encodeTransactionData
key_functions.what: Builds EIP-712 encoded bytes for a SafeTx using SAFE_TX_TYPEHASH, domainSeparator, and all tx/payment/nonce fields.

key_functions.name: getTransactionHash
key_functions.what: Returns keccak256 of encodeTransactionData result.

key_functions.name: setGuard
key_functions.what: Authorized setter for guard address in GUARD_STORAGE_SLOT.

key_functions.name: setFallbackHandler
key_functions.what: Authorized setter for fallback handler in FALLBACK_HANDLER_STORAGE_SLOT.

admin_powers: setGuard / setFallbackHandler via authorized modifier (self-call only)
explainer.upgradeability: Singleton base with private singleton slot for proxy use; no upgrade logic in this contract (proxies delegate to this address).
user_risks: Threshold must be >0 or checkSignatures reverts with GS001
Guard can block/observe all transactions if set
Payment always occurs even on ExecutionFailure
requiredTxGas always reverts and is deprecated
integration_tips: Call setup exactly once via proxy deployment
Use getTransactionHash + execTransaction for multisig flows
Provide at least threshold*65 bytes signatures
Set gasPrice=0 and safeTxGas=0 only for estimation paths that must succeed

explainer.summary: Multicall3 aggregates results from multiple function calls into one transaction using the Call, Call3, and Call3Value structs defined in the source. It implements aggregate, tryAggregate, aggregate3, aggregate3Value and the block/chain view helpers exactly as shown, with all payable aggregate methods forwarding calls via target.call or target.call{value}. The contract contains no owner, admin, or upgrade logic.

key_functions.name: aggregate
key_functions.what: Executes Call[] requiring every call to succeed and returns blockNumber plus returnData array

key_functions.name: tryAggregate
key_functions.what: Executes Call[] and returns Result[] array; reverts only if requireSuccess is true and any call fails

key_functions.name: tryBlockAndAggregate
key_functions.what: Calls tryAggregate then additionally returns current blockNumber and blockHash

key_functions.name: blockAndAggregate
key_functions.what: Wrapper that calls tryBlockAndAggregate(true, calls)

key_functions.name: aggregate3
key_functions.what: Executes Call3[] allowing per-call failure when allowFailure is true, using inline assembly for the revert string

key_functions.name: aggregate3Value
key_functions.what: Executes Call3Value[] forwarding each value, accumulates valAccumulator, and requires msg.value equals the sum

key_functions.name: getEthBalance
key_functions.what: View that returns addr.balance

key_functions.name: getBlockNumber
key_functions.what: View that returns block.number

explainer.upgradeability: None; contract has no proxy, delegatecall, or upgrade functions.
user_risks: Any call with allowFailure=false reverts the whole Multicall3 transaction on failure
aggregate3Value reverts unless msg.value exactly equals sum of call values
No access control; any caller can invoke any public function
integration_tips: Prefer aggregate3 when some calls may legitimately fail
Use tryAggregate(false, ...) to obtain per-call success flags without reverting
Account for the 24-gas savings noted for payable aggregate methods when estimating gas

explainer.summary: ENSRegistryWithFallback inherits from ENSRegistry and adds fallback reads to a prior ENS instance for nodes where recordExists returns false. The constructor accepts an ENS _old reference which is stored immutably; resolver, owner and ttl each delegate to old when the local Record.owner is zero. _setOwner maps a zero owner to address(this) before calling the parent implementation.

key_functions.name: constructor
key_functions.what: Stores the provided ENS _old and calls ENSRegistry constructor which sets records[0x0].owner to msg.sender.

key_functions.name: resolver
key_functions.what: Returns old.resolver(node) when !recordExists(node), otherwise super.resolver(node).

key_functions.name: owner
key_functions.what: Returns old.owner(node) when !recordExists(node), otherwise super.owner(node) which maps address(this) to address(0).

key_functions.name: ttl
key_functions.what: Returns old.ttl(node) when !recordExists(node), otherwise super.ttl(node).

key_functions.name: setOwner
key_functions.what: Authorised modifier check then _setOwner which stores the owner (mapping zero to this) and emits Transfer.

key_functions.name: setSubnodeOwner
key_functions.what: Authorised check, computes subnode = keccak256(node,label), calls _setOwner and emits NewOwner.

key_functions.name: setResolver
key_functions.what: Authorised check, stores resolver and emits NewResolver.

key_functions.name: setTTL
key_functions.what: Authorised check, stores ttl and emits NewTTL.

key_functions.name: setApprovalForAll
key_functions.what: Sets operators[msg.sender][operator] and emits ApprovalForAll.

admin_powers: Initial owner of the root node (0x0) set in ENSRegistry constructor.
explainer.upgradeability: None; the contract is immutable after deployment and only provides read fallback to the supplied old ENS instance.
user_risks: Records not yet migrated remain under control of the old ENS contract whose behavior is outside this contract's scope.
Zero-address owners are stored internally as address(this) and reported as address(0).
integration_tips: Call the ENS interface methods (owner, resolver, ttl, setOwner, etc.) directly on this contract address.
Check recordExists before writes if migration status must be known.

explainer.summary: Seaport 1.5 is deployed as an immutable contract inheriting from Consideration, with constructor accepting a conduitController address. The only visible logic overrides _name via assembly to return 'Seaport' and _nameString to return the literal string. No other functions are defined in the provided Seaport.sol source.

key_functions.name: constructor
key_functions.what: Accepts conduitController address and passes it to Consideration constructor.

key_functions.name: _name
key_functions.what: Internal pure override returning contract name via assembly mstore and return.

key_functions.name: _nameString
key_functions.what: Internal pure override returning the string 'Seaport'.

explainer.upgradeability: Not upgradeable; no proxy or delegatecall mechanisms present in source.

explainer.summary: Lido contract (v2) implements the core liquid staking pool logic on Ethereum, accepting user ETH via submit/fallback, tracking buffered/CL balances via storage slots, and processing oracle reports to rebase shares while handling withdrawals/EL rewards. It inherits Versioned+StETHPermit+AragonApp, uses LidoLocator for external contracts, and enforces ACL roles plus staking limits/pauses. Upgrade path exists via finalizeUpgrade_v2; deposit logic is partially shown calling StakingRouter.

key_functions.name: initialize

explainer.summary: This is the original CryptoPunksMarket contract that tracks ownership of 10000 punks via punkIndexToAddress and balanceOf mappings, with Offer and Bid structs for marketplace activity and pendingWithdrawals for payments. The owner controls initial assignment via setInitialOwner/setInitialOwners until allInitialOwnersAssigned sets the allPunksAssigned flag. All state-changing functions after that point require the flag to be true and enforce ownership checks before transfers, offers, bids or purchases.

key_functions.name: setInitialOwner

key_functions.name: getPunk
key_functions.what: Allows any caller to claim an unassigned punk once allPunksAssigned is true and punks remain.

key_functions.name: transferPunk
key_functions.what: Transfers punk ownership to another address without payment, clearing any active offer and refunding a matching bid.

key_functions.name: offerPunkForSale
key_functions.what: Lists a punk for sale at a minimum price to anyone.

key_functions.name: buyPunk
key_functions.what: Purchases an offered punk if value meets minValue and seller still owns it, updating ownership and queuing payment to seller.

key_functions.name: enterBidForPunk
key_functions.what: Submits a bid higher than any existing bid; refunds the previous bidder via pendingWithdrawals.

key_functions.name: acceptBidForPunk
key_functions.what: Seller accepts the current bid if it meets minPrice, transferring ownership and queuing payment.

key_functions.name: withdraw
key_functions.what: Sends the caller's pendingWithdrawals balance after zeroing the mapping entry to prevent re-entrancy.
